versions.changelog:
- Added curl and jq as required external binaries in the skill metadata for improved clarity on dependencies.
- No functional changes to features or usage. Documentation update only.

- Initial release of the camino-places skill for flexible place lookup and geocoding.
- Supports both free-form (e.g. "Eiffel Tower") and structured address searches.
- Returns coordinates, display names, detailed addresses, and optional street-level photos.
- Provides usage examples for shell scripts and direct curl/API integration.
- Includes detailed parameter documentation and best practices.
- Compatible with the Camino AI skills suite; requires a CAMINO_API_KEY.
